column1: # The runtime images, one per line, tab-separated:
# Tab-separated so the scripts that read it need no parser.
# kind: `mirror` rows are copied unchanged by scripts/mirror.sh. `build` marks
# an image we publish from our own build, of pinned upstream source or of the
# build context itself; the build is scripts/build.sh <name>, from
# build/<name>/. A `build` row's ref is our own published tag
# (ghcr.io/blaktron/<name>:<tag>) and its digest is that tag's manifest, so
# scripts/pin.sh reports a tag that was pushed again; scripts/mirror.sh skips
# Every upstream ref is pinned by digest. scripts/pin.sh reports tags that have
# moved and never edits this file.
# The Agentry server's own images (postgres, minio, redis, the edge, authentik,
# opensearch, secureagentryd) are not listed here.
